title: ModalForm: an `lg` / `xl` dialog runs edge to edge between `sm` and its max width (no viewport margin), now reached by every field-heavy create/edit at 640–1078 px
body:
Filing gate ①: a measured residue of objectui#12521's interim (PR #12546). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`) from the landing browser reading. ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

reach: every desktop window between `sm` (640 px) and an `xl` dialog's 1024 px max width, or an `lg` dialog's 672 px, wherever `ModalForm` draws `lg` / `xl`. Since PR #12546 that includes every field-heavy create/edit in the console. Before it, only an authored `modalSize: 'xl'` reached this.

## Measured (HotCRM Leads → New, PR #12546 head `91fd2dbe68` against `main` `3eb3ec138a`)

| Viewport | Head | Base |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1440 × 900 | 1024 px, centred | 1368 px (`95vw`) |
| 1024 × 768 | 1024 px at x = 0, edge to edge | 972.8 px (`95vw`) |
| 768 | 768 px at x = 0, edge to edge | 729.6 px |

**Mechanism.** `ModalForm`'s size map is `lg` → `sm:max-w-2xl` and `xl` → `sm:max-w-5xl`, with `w-full`. Below the max width there is nothing to keep a margin, so the dialog takes the whole viewport width. The `full` size keeps 5 % (`sm:max-w-[95vw]`).

## Ask (for triage to scope)

The bounded sizes keep a viewport margin at every width from `sm` up, for example `max-w` of `min(64rem, 100vw − 2rem)` for `xl`. The phone sheet below `sm` is unchanged.

**Pins:**
- an `xl` dialog at 1024 px and at 768 px leaves a margin on both sides;
- at 1440 px it is still 1024 px;
- CONTROL: the phone sheet at 390 px is unchanged.

Dedupe (titles read in this act: "ModalForm size margin", "dialog edge to edge", "max-w-5xl viewport"): none.
